dedupe_keys.name: optibus ai powered public transport planning scheduling and operations platform

description: Optibus is a commercial, cloud-native platform for planning and operating public transport, aimed at authorities and cities, operators, shuttle services and consultancies. Its site lists network optimisation, operator KPI dashboards and compliance reporting, service impact analysis and scenario planning for tenders, mixed-fleet management, AI-based generation of schedules and vehicle and crew allocation, dynamic shuttle route optimisation, and modules for planning, scheduling, operations, an agent, and control and monitoring. Coverage: operators worldwide. Format and access: hosted software under commercial terms. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid; no prices are stated. Caveats: a marketing site; algorithms, data formats and validation are not documented on the page. It supports optimisation and capacity planning of timetables, vehicle blocks and crew rosters. It relates to Remix and PTV Lines in the catalogue.
